correctness.rationale: Contracting the n-c bridges of a connected unicyclic graph gives T_G=x^(n-c)(y+x+...+x^(c-1)); at fixed order the cycle length can also be read from T_G(1,1). An independent census over labelled edge sets, canonically quotiented and using the subset-rank definition of the actual Tutte polynomial, gives 1,2,5,13 unlabelled classes and only the two listed ties, at n=6. Structurally, cycle length 3 at n=6 allows attachment-size patterns (3,0,0), (2,1,0) and (1,1,1) with 4,2,1 rooted-tree possibilities, respectively. Only the attached fork and the chain-plus-leaf repeat a degree profile. For c=4 the two extra vertices give a single chain, two leaves at one vertex, or one leaf at each of two vertices either adjacent or opposite; only the latter pair ties. The other cycle lengths at n=6 give one graph each. Nomizu's theorem identifies the dimensions with those of the graph CE complex (which is defined over Q and extends to the real invariant complex). Exact rational elimination in an independent implementation confirms every differential rank and Betti entry in the four vectors, including the total ranks 1280/1320 and 1280/1316 and the splits 76/75 and 76/77 at degree three. The replay also checks d squared on all 4096 basis monomials per graph, Poincare duality and Euler characteristic.
residual_risks: The reported ancillary NetworkX/SymPy author implementation was not independently authenticated or relied upon.

value.rationale: Degree sequence and the Tutte polynomial are natural joint graph descriptors. The exact totals show that even the total rational cohomology is not fixed by the joint invariants, a stronger information-loss statement than finding a difference at one degree. The complete pairs at the first possible order give concrete counterexamples and exact benchmark profiles for broader formulas, not simply new names for the known four-cycle pair or a substitution into a low-degree formula.
residual_risks: Minimality applies only to these invariants among connected simple unicyclic graphs. No claim on ring type or larger order follows.
